title: DOW-UAP-D27, Mission Report, United Arab Emirates, October 2023
doc_notes: This is a declassified Department of War mission report containing a single UAP encounter report.

encounters.summary: A glowing hot spherical object with a vertical cylindrical pole attached to the bottom was observed moving at 140 knots over water.
encounters.entity_appearance: glowing hot spherical object with a vertical unwavering cylindrical pole/bar attached on the bottom
encounters.entity_behavior: flying straight just over the water at speed of 140 knots
encounters.quote: GLOWING HOT SPHERICAL UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT WITH A VERTICAL UNWAVERING CYLINDRICAL POLE/BAR ATTACHED ON THE BOTTOM
